name: music-toggle-button
title: Music Toggle Button
description: A compact play and pause button with five thin waveform bars that spring to random heights while playing and settle flat when paused. The pill swells on hover and press.
use: A music card or header needs a small play or pause control that signals sound with moving bars.
avoid: The bars are tiny and the button has no visible text, so its purpose depends on surrounding track details.
a11y: It is a div with role button and aria-pressed but no tabIndex or key handler, so it cannot be focused or activated from the keyboard. (keyboard: no, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A black circular button holding five thin vertical white bars, sitting inside a dark rounded card beside an album thumbnail, track title, artist name and a thin progress line. The bars read like a tiny equaliser.
behaves: Clicking toggles playback: the bars spring to staggered heights on a fast loop while the button pads outward, then collapse to even stubs when paused. Hovering and pressing swell the pill.
customise: Only the audio source, starting playing state and class name are props. Bar count, animation timing and the wrapper styling are fixed in the source.
weight: light: A tiny five-bar animation on a single button; idle when paused.
